description: List what every Clipwright tool costs in credits. Free, spends nothing. Each entry names the tool, its REST route and its price: lines of credits per unit (call, second of video, second the presenter is in the video, image, clip, second of clip), added up, with minimum_credits when there is one; or, where the price depends on the input, a formula. Free tools cost 0. For the exact number of a paid call, use the quote tool the entry names.
name: list_prices
title: List prices
